page.layout: One page of text, full width; running head at top centre; a woodcut ornament below the text. No margin notes.

main_text.p: das diuino numini gratias, quod nos a miseriis hisce benignitate sua vindicavit, incitentur: tum etiam ad colendam eorum memoriam, quorum operatant ares effecta. Denique vt cognita Hispanicæ gentis crudelitate, ac perfidia adlaborent propulsare a ceruicibus suis iugum ipsorum. Boni igitur consule amice lector hunc laborem meum & felix ac sospes freure. Vale

page.notes: The first line is a fragment running from the previous page. The text is set in italic type throughout. The ornament below the text is a woodcut and is not transcribed. Several words are faint or damaged in the scan, and "ares effecta" and "freure" may be misprints for printed forms; the scan is not clear enough to confirm them. "vindicavit" and "Hispanicæ" are read as printed.
